title: Weak convergence from projected laws on a positive-measure set of directions
summary: The Cramér-Wold device characterises weak convergence of probability measures on $\mathbb{R}^d$ through convergence of all one-dimensional projected laws. We prove that, if the target projected laws are moment-determinate for surface-almost every direction, then weak convergence already follows from projected convergence on a positive-measure set of directions.
